name: Gen AI Bots
benefit: Answers repetitive questions instantly from company documents, cutting support workload.
typical_metrics: 30-60% fewer tickets handled by humans; response time from hours to seconds

name: Voice AI
benefit: AI agents handle inbound and outbound calls 24/7 in multiple languages.
typical_metrics: 40-70% lower cost per call; higher contact rate on outbound campaigns

name: Conversational AI
benefit: Engages customers in natural chat or voice, guides them to purchase and captures leads.

name: AI Video Personalization
benefit: Creates one-to-one videos with the customer's name, offer or usage data at scale.
typical_metrics: 2-5x higher click-through; 20-40% lift in conversion vs generic video

name: Visual AI / Computer Vision
benefit: Cameras and images are analysed automatically to detect defects, stock gaps and safety issues.
typical_metrics: Fewer defects and stock-outs; large reduction in manual inspection time

name: Face AI
benefit: Fast, contactless identity verification with consent and secure data handling.
typical_metrics: KYC time from days to minutes; reduced fraud and manual checks

name: AI Competitor Monitoring
benefit: Tracks competitors' prices, ads, launches and sentiment automatically so the brand reacts fast.
typical_metrics: Faster pricing and campaign decisions; better win rates

name: AI for Digital Ads Performance
benefit: Optimises bids, creatives and audiences to improve return on ad spend.
typical_metrics: 10-30% lower cost per acquisition; higher ROAS
